## Patterns
| Keyword | Description | Example |
|---------|-------------|---------|
| `documentSchemas` | Top-level key in a contract JSON holding all document type schemas (new SDK / WASM SDK format) | `{ "documentSchemas": { "profile": { "type": "object", ... } } }` |
| `documents` | Legacy top-level key for document type schemas (older contract JSON format) | `{ "documents": { "profile": { "type": "object", ... } } }` |
| Index definition | JSON schema for an index with a properties array and optional unique flag | `{ "name": "ownerIndex", "properties": [{ "$ownerId": "asc" }], "unique": true }` |
| Contested index | Index with `"contested": true` resolved by masternode vote (DPNS username slot) | `{ "name": "usernameIndex", "properties": [{"normalizedLabel": "asc"}], "unique": true, "contested": true }` |
| `documentsKeepHistory` | Per-doctype flag enabling document history storage | `"documentsKeepHistory": true` |
| `documentsMutable` | Per-doctype flag enabling document updates after creation | `"documentsMutable": true` |
| `canBeDeleted` | Per-doctype flag enabling document deletion | `"canBeDeleted": true` |
| `transferable` | Per-doctype flag (0=Never, 1=Always) enabling document NFT transfer | `"transferable": 1` |
| `creationRestrictionMode` | Per-doctype (0=none, 1=owner-only, 2=no-creation) | `"creationRestrictionMode": 1` |
| `signatureSecurityLevelRequirement` | Per-doctype minimum identity key security level (0=master, 1=critical, 2=high, 3=medium) | `"signatureSecurityLevelRequirement": 2` |
| `$defs` | Shared subschema definitions reused across document types via `$ref` | `"$defs": { "base58Id": { "type": "array", "byteArray": true, ... } }` |
| `byteArray` | Field modifier making a JSON `array` field binary (byte string) | `{ "type": "array", "byteArray": true, "minItems": 32, "maxItems": 32 }` |
| `contentMediaType` | Field annotation for binary fields; `application/x.dash.dpp.identifier` marks an Identifier | `"contentMediaType": "application/x.dash.dpp.identifier"` |
| `position` | Required per-property integer for deterministic serialization order | `"position": 0` |
| `additionalProperties` | Must be `false` in every document type schema | `"additionalProperties": false` |
| Token config with owner minting | Minimal token with base supply and contract owner minting rights | `{ "baseSupply": 100000, "manualMintingRules": { "authorizedToMakeChange": "contractOwner" } }` |
| Group definition | Group with two members each holding power 1, requiring power 2 (both must sign) | `{ "members": { "<id1>": 1, "<id2>": 1 }, "requiredPower": 2 }` |
| `keywords` | V1 contract search keywords array (max 50 unique strings) | `"keywords": ["social", "messaging", "dash"]` |
| `$schema` | Legacy contract schema URL field (not required in new format) | `"$schema": "https://schema.dash.org/dpp-0-4-0/meta/data-contract"` |
